title: Privacy & Consent Management
subtitle: Control your data sharing preferences and exercise data protection rights
withdrawConfirm: Withdraw consent now? This immediately deletes derived synthetic caches and drafts and ends the demo session.
purgeNotice: In this prototype, withdrawal immediately deletes derived dashboard caches, provider snapshots, and incomplete applications; completed receipts are pseudonymized.
syntheticFixturesRetained: Fictional synthetic source fixtures remain in the demo environment for testing continuity.
withdrawalSimulatedBody: Withdrawal completed for derived synthetic records. Fictional source fixtures were retained for repeatable testing.
futurePurgeDescription: In a production system, this action would permanently purge temporary cached records from all participating registries.
